name: velo
description: Velo V2 Ask and Plan modes for Codex — read-only conceptual Q&A, plus persisted, versioned planning with an explicit approval freeze.

interface.shortDescription: Conceptual Q&A and approval-gated planning for Codex (Velo V2 — Ask and Plan)
interface.longDescription: Velo V2 ships two modes. Ask answers conceptual engineering questions from model knowledge and the current conversation only — it never reads the repository, runs commands, browses, uses connectors, spawns agents, or writes artifacts, and it creates no durable state of any kind. Plan turns a brief into a persisted, versioned plan saved under .velo/ — it may read the repository to plan well, writes only under .velo/, offers explicit approval that freezes the plan version, and never executes the plan. Requests to execute work get a plain explanation and an offer to plan; Run and Auto are future routes neither mode starts.
defaultPrompt: Ask Velo a conceptual engineering question
Talk a design trade-off through without touching the repo
Plan a feature into a saved, versioned plan under .velo/
Revise a saved plan and approve it to freeze the version
